selected_script.angle: Preventing accidental laundry room clutter collapses and reclaiming vertical wall space with secure roller clips
selected_script.hook: Getting hit on the shoulder by a sliding broom handle every single time you open the utility closet.

script_record.0-1.5s: Close-up of a messy closet corner where a metal broom handle slips and falls onto the floor.
script_record.1.5-3s: An adult son wearing a shiny silver astronaut helmet and formal tuxedo walks backward into the laundry room carrying the light-gray mop holder, saying 'Problem solved!'.
script_record.3-6s: The light-gray mop holder with 5 white silicone roller clips and 5 J-hooks is mounted on a tiled wall, holding a broom handle securely.
script_record.6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1: A close-up of a hand easily pushing a broom handle into a white silicone roller clip.
script_record.10-14s: Fast-cut scene 2: Small cleaning brushes and towels hanging neatly from the 5 gray downward J-hooks.
script_record.14-18s: Fast-cut scene 3: Wide shot of a neat, organized utility closet wall with five upright tools mounted off the floor.
script_record.18-20s: CTA: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'
